request.source_text: OK, it's starting to become more useful now.  But turns that don't have any tagging (like this one) should trigger additional analysis.  What I'd like ultimately is to start to fit my turns to the flexiarg library.  Right now that's done via an embedding.  But we could eventually do it via a complex cascading templating or rewriting system.  However that won't work if the turns have no structural markup.
